g.text: Target Fixed Snapshot Paging - Oldest First Candidate
Read branch leaf and committed upper bound
Encode bound continuation if more records
Commit new complete event after upper bound
New records do not enter the earlier snapshot.
Verify session, integrity, expiry and versions
Read pinned branch within fixed upper bound
Encode next position or return null
null means snapshot exhausted, not execution finished.
Start a fresh first page to include newer commits.
No automatic replay of accepted POST requests.
